description: pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs:470,477 — verify_responder_id_impl returns Err(Error::OcspSignatureInvalid) when the ResponderId byName or byKey value does not match the expected issuer identity. An identity check failure is semantically distinct from a signature verification failure. Callers logging or branching on OcspSignatureInvalid will incorrectly attribute the failure to a bad signature rather than a wrong responder identity. A dedicated variant (e.g. OcspResponderIdMismatch) or reuse of OcspCertIdMismatch would be clearer. The doc comment at line 428 notes this is intentional, but the caller semantics remain confusing for diagnostic purposes.
title: verify_responder_id returns OcspSignatureInvalid on ID mismatch
